in_marathi.name: Ajai
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Not Born Yet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ajai is derived from the Sanskrit language and translates to ‘Not Born Yet’. This name was given to children who were born prematurely or whose parents had lost hope of having a child.
